summary: For content encrypted with different vault IDs, pass multiple --vault-id options; Ansible tries the password with the matching label first, then the others in command-line order, and for unlabeled content in the order given.
questions: How do I pass both dev and prod vault passwords to one playbook?
In what order does Ansible try vault passwords?
What happens if encrypted data has no vault ID label?

answer_card.title: Passing multiple vault passwords
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-playbook --vault-id dev@dev-password --vault-id prod@prompt site.yml
```

Labels are hints. Ansible tries the password whose label matches the data first, then the others in command-line order. For unlabeled or unmatched data, passwords are tried in the order given (here `dev`, then `prod`).
